assumptions.claim: Users will complete a five-step setup without assistance.
assumptions.limits: Synthetic illustration; no real users observed.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Setup scope and support burden may be misestimated.
assumptions.confirmation_method: Observe a consented usability study and record completion without assistance.
assumptions.disproof_method: Fewer than four of five eligible participants complete without assistance.

task_effects.reason: Setup scope depends on the assumption.
task_effects.reassessment_trigger: Reopen if evidence disproves unaided completion.

task_effects.reason: Help content can be drafted independently.
task_effects.reassessment_trigger: Reassess only if content work starts depending on setup completion.

experiments.hypothesis: A five-step setup is understandable without assistance.
experiments.prediction: At least four of five participants complete unaided.
experiments.wrong_if: Fewer than four of five participants complete unaided.
experiments.method: Moderated usability sessions with consent and a fixed task script.
experiments.sample_data_limits: Synthetic tabletop example only; five participants would not estimate population demand.
experiments.privacy_handling: Use consented notes; collect no unnecessary identifiers; retain per approved research plan.
experiments.decision_rule: Owner reviews actual results and limitations; no automatic scope change.
